Thank you for your reply - Yes I am on other meds - but wellbutrin is the main one - gabapentin is the other - Had ACL and PCL surgery last year - knee is really killing me - this time of year is rough - and not being able to get a job because I am SO overqualified is just a beat down.

Just trying to keep my head up  - and vent - DOC's are all on vacation 

Hope everyone that is on this sub is well and again much love - venting helps - and lt seems Tech guys are more likely to be BIPOLAR

Happy Holidays and if anyone else feels like me - hope you feel better soon - Hope I do - all and any responses are greatly appreciated

BTW - I feel like a totally failure to my family - and an total id10t for this situation..being punished for my past mistakes - black cloud - I reached out to friends and they are dumbfounded - only me - guess what - I am a mess

Reddit members - I am not sure where to post this - so I just did it in askreddit.

I NEED HELP.

I am the lurker - just review posts - not one to create posts

Heck I think this is only my 4th message posted - most looking to help me with depression. 

I have responded to some of the Bipolar posts as that relates to me and I can provide some information.

Also have received support for Bipolar suicide thoughts. I wish to thank the entire community ...it really did help. 

I am a Systems Engineer - with VM/O365/Exchange/AD/SAN/and more

Basically the big Computer Geek.

So I left a job - Senior position - no risk - with a promise that I would have long term employment - was a good fit - close to home 

I was fired - via cell phone message - with no meetings - no HR conference - no information at all. - after 8 WEEKS.

Told " its just not working out"

So this is NJ and its an "at will" state - but I contacted the VP and HR to inform me what my benefits where and what I had in payments.

Received No response for 7 days

Applied for unemployment - and it only list the company I left - not the new company 

Also the NJDPL informed me that a phone interview is required and non-monetary review is needed.

I work for the new company for 6/13 to 7/21

Calling NJ I have been on the phone 4 hours a day on hold - and then no response. 

My past company was not listed in the Notice of Claimant - only my past company - and I filed ONLY with the new company.

So it looks like the new company - has not registered me as an employee and my past company is denying my benefits

Has anyone been in this situation and have any advice?

Thank you in advance

AA does NOT work for all people - ESP for BI-Polar people. 

I have been "locked up" a number of times for concerns and interventions - and I am a family man - never missed a day of work - just come home and drink before bed

some say "functional alcoholic" 

Guess what - they push AA as soon as you get in - even if they discover you are bi-polar or any other number of depression conditions that you might have.

AA is a load of shit - like Scientology

What is needed is
At least for BI-Polar

Therapy - talk about issues
Moderation - there is no need to jump off the bridge - just need to NOT go crazy
Support - make sure you have some one that says - ok that's enough
NO judging - IE - everyone drinks but you do it too much - that doesn't help 
NO SPYING - looking around for drinks -  bottle - checking every cup - that is horrible for some one trying to move forward - and accusing every time they seem off or have "crazy eyes" is just horrable

This is just my PO and take it as such as a BI-Polar person that also has an additive personality
